title: Is Overemployment Illegal Now?
description:
Every time I mention my overemployment, people lean in like I’m selling black market kidneys—
“Wait… is that even legal?” they whisper.

“Sorta,” I say, dodging the 15-minute TED Talk.

But after getting this question one too many times, here’s the full answer—plus some tactical ways to avoid getting busted.
